diagnoses: Complex open wound of the right leg with an MRSA skin infection (cellulitis)
Leg swelling thought to be from poor vein circulation (chronic venostasis), likely partly from the liver
medicines: Doxycycline 100 mg by mouth twice a day for 10 days
Prescriptions for Percocet and OxyContin, to pick up at the office
dates: In hospital from 03/26/08; much better by 04/03/08
Follow-up in a couple of weeks
actions: Wrap the leg with an Ace bandage (compression)
